company.name: Delphix
company.shortDescription: Delphix provides an intelligent data platform that accelerates digital transformation for companies around the world.
company.description:
Delphix provides an intelligent data platform that accelerates digital transformation for companies around the world. Its DataOps platform supports a broad spectrum of systems from mainframes to Oracle databases, ERP applications, and Kubernetes containers. 

The company was founded in 2008 and is headquartered in Redwood City, California.

aiResearchSummary.text: Delphix Corp. is focused on enhancing data security and privacy during digital transformation processes. Their research includes developing systems for continuous real-time masked database replication. This involves masking data in change logs from a source database, generating masked change logs, and storing them in a pre-buffer to ensure secure data handling and replication without compromising real-time data availability.
